nodes.label: ADR-004: Frontend Temporal Runtime Model
nodes.rationale: Widening one concept across Temporal/string/numeric forms, lingering Date usage, and identity-keyed Temporal handling reintroduced runtime bugs and obscured boundaries.

nodes.label: Temporal-Only Runtime Model
nodes.rationale: Frontend runtime and domain logic use Temporal, never Date; one concept is either an encoded boundary form or a Temporal value, never a mixed union; native Date is allowed only behind explicit third-party adapters.

nodes.label: Temporal Value Semantics
nodes.rationale: Temporal values are value-keyed domain data: use .equals, Temporal.*.compare, or value-keyed wrappers instead of object identity in sets and maps; avoid relational operators on Temporal objects.
